# Trimmed capture of the Dynamo frontend's /metrics (dynamo 1.4.2, :11434).
# Two served models: one generate model and one embedding model.
# Counters/histograms only — the frontend exports no dynamo_frontend_model_ready
# in 1.4.2, which is why central derives readiness from etcd instances instead.
# HELP dynamo_frontend_requests_total Total requests processed by the frontend
# TYPE dynamo_frontend_requests_total counter
dynamo_frontend_requests_total{model="openai/gpt-oss-120b"} 1200
dynamo_frontend_requests_total{model="Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B"} 48

# HELP dynamo_frontend_active_requests Requests currently in flight
# TYPE dynamo_frontend_active_requests gauge
dynamo_frontend_active_requests{model="openai/gpt-oss-120b"} 3
dynamo_frontend_active_requests{model="Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B"} 0

# HELP dynamo_frontend_queued_requests Requests waiting for a worker
# TYPE dynamo_frontend_queued_requests gauge
dynamo_frontend_queued_requests{model="openai/gpt-oss-120b"} 2
